==Notes==
*All [[action]]s (including skill activations, attacks, and movement) will be [[cancel]]ed when this form ends.
*The +20 Armor reduces incoming physical damage by roughly 29%. 
*This form uses male [[warrior]] animations, regardless of your [[character]]'s gender or profession.
*The [[hero]] [[M.O.X.]] has a unique model for this form.
*The [[Zaishen Tonic]] has a chance to turn you into this form (see [[Avatar of Balthazar Form]]).

== Trivia ==
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill revision history]] for details.
